method: Identical previous full-operation scenario; no infrastructure/configuration changes. Tokyo and Virginia prices freshly retrieved. Not a global cheapest-region survey.

assumptions.tasks: Node 0.5vCPU/1GiB, Go 0.25vCPU/1GiB, ARM64 on-demand. Revised after 2026-10-18 local constrained test; AWS unverified.
assumptions.db: single-AZ db.t4g.micro, PostgreSQL normal support, gp3 20GiB
assumptions.egress: 30GiB; AWS aggregate free allowance remaining; no NAT
assumptions.storage: S3 all object versions and dumps combined 6GiB; ECR total 2GiB
assumptions.usage: 100k external HTTP calls and 100k DiscoverInstances calls; DNS100k; these are scenario counts, not measured
assumptions.fees: USD pretax; domain renewal/CI excluded; probes/notification allowance not actual implemented system cost

notes: Public+private hosted zones and public query allowance retained from prior full-operation scenario; current no-domain validation does not create public zone.
CrossAZ10GiBAllowance and ProbeAndNotificationAllowance remain same budget reserves, not measured use or newly verified regional tariffs.
Same-region API, app, DB, storage assumed. No Tokyo-US cross-region traffic or CDN added.
Monthly baseline assumes 30GiB internet egress covered by remaining account-level 100GB/month allowance; other resource free allowances not subtracted.
Reserved contracts, Spot and temporary credits not used; tax, FX, domain renewal and paid CI excluded. Updates, CPU credits, excess snapshots/backup/storage and increased usage can add costs.
Tokyo-approved trial not automatically approved or deployed in another region; Tokyo-specific templates remain unchanged.
